messages:
maria: rolling out smart-burst + proxy-quant profile to prod canary now (10% traffic). primary goal: reduce p50 tail at high concurrency and cut token compute cost. will post numbers after first hour. :rocket:
infra-bot: deployed service/runtime-proxy v3.4.1-canary to prod cluster-a with tag=proxy-quant-smartburst canary=10%
alex: nice — what benchmark workload are we using for measurements?
maria: using mix of chat_short (median 32 tokens) and assistant_long (median 180 tokens) with realistic concurrency shape from last week's traffic. baseline = v3.3.8 (no proxy-quant).
ben: any eval on generation quality? quantization sometimes nudges logits — want to avoid user-visible regressions.
maria: ran 5k eval prompts across top-3 models we serve. quality delta ~= 0.2% BLEU-equivalent on our internal metric, below alert threshold. spot-check examples in the canary eval gist: https://internal.gist/redwood/qp-eval-214432
jess: what's the rollback plan / alerting if p95 or quality regresses?
maria: rollback playbook: 
```
# rollback steps (manual)
1) pause canary: infractl canary pause --service runtime-proxy --tag proxy-quant-smartburst
2) scale old version: infractl deploy --service runtime-proxy --tag v3.3.8 --scale 20%
3) open incident channel and tag @oncall
```
Alerting: p95 latency >= baseline*1.15 or community-quality-regression >= 1.0% will trigger automatic pause and page oncall.
sam_k: I'll wire up a short-term dashboard: p50/p95/p99, cost_per_token, regen_quality_score. hooking to datadog charts and the runtime console. will post dashboard link in 10m.
infra-bot: canary progress: 10% -> 50% at 2144322800 (automated ramp).
maria: first hour numbers from 50% canary (compare to baseline): p50 reduced 12% (from 82ms -> 72ms), p95 reduced 9% (from 210ms -> 191ms), median token compute cost down 18% (measured on same GPU mix). overall 1M tokens cost delta: ~$0.27 -> ~$0.22.
alex: those are solid. curious about tail at high concurrency — any p99 numbers?
maria: p99 at 50% canary ~ +1% (no meaningful regression). that was a concern but we think the proxy-level batching avoids large spikes.
ben: did you test with KV-cache heavy sessions? some of our customers open long chats.
maria: yes, KV-heavy synthetic load included. small increase in slot eviction but net benefit in token cost. we've added a micro-evict throttle to keep memory stable.
jess: ok proceed with full rollout if no alerts in next 3h. please ensure we have a post-rollout note for customer-success & docs.
maria: agree. plan: automated ramp to 100% over 1h if no alerts. starting ramp in 15m. ping me in-thread for status. :eyes: 
infra-bot: canary progress: 50% -> 100% at 2144324400. rollout complete. post-rollout summary will follow. :white_check_mark:
maria: TL;DR — proxy-quant + smart-burst fully rolled out. p50 down ~12%, p95 down ~9%, token compute cost down ~18%. no quality regressions detected. thanks to the runtime and infra teams for the fast turnaround. please add any anomalies below.
sam_k: monitoring looks good. will keep 24h watch and hand off to oncall for standard SLO guardrails.
ben: marking for docs team: update quantization notes + tuning guide. cc @docs.
alex: nice work all. :tada:
